items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would start my set with Dave Brubeck. The… Your Sweet, you know.

ctx.x: No, we do. For instance, we have… I have some great musicians I [inaudible]. We’re doing some jobs, you know, with some European rhythm section. They’re good. Then we… but I like to play what… okay, I [would?] start my set with Dave Brubeck. The… Your Sweet, you know.
